detail.title: MK1500 Mini 60% Pro RGB Wireless Gaming Keyboard
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MK1500 BT combines portability and everyday productivity in a 60% wireless keyboard that pairs with PCs, laptops and Bluetooth-enabled handheld devices like phones and tablets. Membrane keys rated for 50 million clicks sit under a floating keycap design, with vibrant multi-colour RGB backlighting diffused through a premium polymer shell for a striking look in low light. Bluetooth connectivity delivers a stable range of up to 5 metres with no extra adapters required, and a 1000mAh battery keeps it running for around 100 hours of continuous use or over 250 hours on standby, recharging quickly via the included USB Type-C cable. At just 556g, it's light enough to toss in a bag for travel while remaining a genuinely capable everyday keyboard.
